description: This PHP file defines an administrative controller class for managing language-related tasks within an OpenCart e-commerce project. It includes methods for generating language lists for stores, listing language configurations, and clearing language JSON files.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing language list data generation, listing language configurations, and cleaning up language JSON files across stores in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates language tasks for all stores, initializing with the default store, and schedules language list tasks.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and generates a JSON language data file for a specified store based on store ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing language JSON files for all stores and languages.
